headline: Resolution opposing Pioneer Charter School of Science expansion approved; smart glasses policy gets first reading.
summary: The committee approved its consent agenda, including a Salem High basketball trip to Orlando. It also heard public comment on a federal school voucher program and on school resource officers. Members discussed police officers in schools and late athletic bus trips, and they plan a special meeting on the officers.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the October 19 minutes, a Salem High basketball trip to Orlando, and two warrants, unanimously.
Approved first reading of a policy banning smart glasses and covert recording devices, unanimously.
Approved resolution opposing the Pioneer Charter School of Science's expansion application, unanimously.
discussion: School resource officers: Principals shared how officers work with students, and members said the agreement with police has not been signed by both sides since 2022.
Athletic bus trips: Members discussed buses that ran late for playoff games, a contract of about $500 a day, and whether the district could use a larger bus.
Bus stop arm trial: Members discussed a trial of a bus stop arm device, its cost, and how to measure whether it works.
Federal voucher program: A resident asked the committee to speak out against the federal school voucher program.
